The pattern is uniform and abstract with no distinct subject, creating a high-frequency visual noise that reads as a neutral textured backdrop at distance and reveals legible microtext up close. direct/images/woman-grocery-checkout-con.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic shot of a female customer at a supermarket checkout handing a contactless card to a cashier who holds a payment terminal. reusable/images/ads-megaphone-flat-icon..title: Ads Megaphone Flat Icon
reusable/images/ads-megaphone-flat-icon..detailedDescription: Square flat-icon PNG depicting a stylized megaphone (bullhorn) angled to the right with three radiating sound-wave marks and two small rectangular 'ad' cards emerging from the horn. Clean, single-layer vector look with bold flat fills, rounded corners and crisp edges. Color palette uses a high-contrast combination (deep blue main body, vibrant orange accent, white details) on a transparent background. Designed for clear legibility at small UI sizes and easy color swapping or motion-ready animation.
reusable/images/ads-megaphone-flat-icon..visualDifference: Filled flat-icon vs outline or photorealistic icons; single-layer, high-contrast color blocking rather than gradients or textures; centered compact composition optimized for square thumbnails; scalable vector-style shapes that preserve clarity at very small sizes and are easy to animate (sound lines and ad rectangles separate elements).
reusable/images/ads-megaphone-flat-icon..useCase: Short reel shot overlay for promo/marketing segments — appears as a 0.5–1s CTA or transition element (megaphone pulses and sound lines animate while ad cards slide in) to signal ads, promotions, or campaign announcements.
reusable/images/ads-megaphone-flat-icon..use_case: Short reel shot overlay for promo/marketing segments — appears as a 0.5–1s CTA or transition element (megaphone pulses and sound lines animate while ad cards slide in) to signal ads, promotions, or campaign announcements.

reusable/images/ai-network-orb-3d-card.p.title: Ai Network Orb 3d Card
reusable/images/ai-network-orb-3d-card.p.detailedDescription: High-fidelity 3D icon card featuring a glowing neon-green AI network orb suspended above a stacked, rounded rectangular card base. The orb is constructed from a semi-transparent sphere with an internal wireframe of nodes and connecting lines that emit soft bloom and subtle particle glows. The card base uses a layered teal-to-deep-blue gradient with beveled edges, soft reflections, and a faint drop shadow to create a tactile, perspective-driven presentation. Overall composition reads as a premium tech UI asset suitable for overlays, intros, and feature-callouts.
reusable/images/ai-network-orb-3d-card.p.visualDifference: Unlike flat or line-style AI icons, this asset is a volumetric 3D render with internal node-and-edge wireframe detail, pronounced bloom and particle effects, layered card-depth with glossy reflections, and a strong neon green vs deep teal contrast that emphasizes dimensionality and premium feel.
reusable/images/ai-network-orb-3d-card.p.useCase: Short reel shot: 1–3 second hero reveal or transition—orb rises and glows above the card while particles bloom, used as an intro, feature callout, or overlay in AI/tech product demos and app UI walkthroughs.
reusable/images/ai-network-orb-3d-card.p.use_case: Short reel shot: 1–3 second hero reveal or transition—orb rises and glows above the card while particles bloom, used as an intro, feature callout, or overlay in AI/tech product demos and app UI walkthroughs.

reusable/images/amber-glow-warning-trian.title: Amber Glow Warning Triangle Icon
reusable/images/amber-glow-warning-trian.detailedDescription: Centered 3D-style yellow triangular warning icon with a bold black exclamation mark. The triangle has a rounded shape and a double black outline; it sits above a subtle drop shadow and emits a warm amber glow that fades into a cool metallic gray gradient background with faint vertical streaks. High contrast, simple geometry, and soft lighting give it a modern, attention-grabbing appearance suitable for UI and motion overlays.
reusable/images/amber-glow-warning-trian.visualDifference: Unlike flat warning icons, this asset features a soft amber halo glow, 3D depth with shadowing, a double black border around a rounded triangle, and a metallic textured gray backdrop with vertical streaks; the glow intensity, rounded corners, and center composition set it apart from minimal flat icons.

reusable/images/approved-stamp-checkmark.title: Approved Stamp Checkmark
reusable/images/approved-stamp-checkmark.detailedDescription: Flat gradient icon of a classic rubber stamp silhouette with a circular checkmark badge overlapping the lower-left. The stamp body and handle use a smooth teal-to-lime gradient; the check badge shifts to a yellow-green gradient with a bold dark check glyph. Clean, geometric shapes and rounded corners, no text, transparent background — optimized for UI and short video overlays where clarity at small sizes is important.

reusable/images/avatar-user-circle-solid.title: Avatar User Circle Solid

reusable/images/gold-white-3d-arrow-over.title: Gold White 3d Arrow Overlays
reusable/images/gold-white-3d-arrow-over.detailedDescription: A vertical sheet of assorted 3D arrow icons arranged in columns on a subtle brushed-gray background. The set includes single-headed arrows, curved arrows, chevrons, multi-chevron sequences, small directional ticks, a plus symbol, and a circular up-arrow badge. Icons alternate between polished white and metallic gold finishes with soft rim lighting, beveled edges, subtle drop shadows and gentle specular highlights that create a premium, illuminated look. Sizes and stroke weights vary to provide distinct visual emphasis for UI overlays and motion-design callouts.
reusable/images/gold-white-3d-arrow-over.visualDifference: Unlike flat or line icon packs, this asset uses 3D beveling, metallic gold accents and soft halo glows against a brushed-metal backdrop, offering tangible depth and luxury feel. It contains multiple arrow styles (curved vs straight, single vs stacked chevrons, segmented arrows) and a circular badge element, enabling varied direction and transition cues in the same set.
reusable/images/gold-white-3d-arrow-over.useCase: Overlay or cutaway in short reels for transitions, animated callouts, UI walkthroughs, directional emphasis, and premium CTA animations pointing to interface elements.
reusable/images/gold-white-3d-arrow-over.use_case: Overlay or cutaway in short reels for transitions, animated callouts, UI walkthroughs, directional emphasis, and premium CTA animations pointing to interface elements.

reusable/images/metallic-gold-silver-arr.title: Metallic Gold Silver Arrow Overlays Sheet
reusable/images/metallic-gold-silver-arr.detailedDescription: High-resolution icon sheet showing a variety of 3D metallic arrows and chevrons arranged in a neat grid on a brushed metal gradient backdrop. The set includes curved arrows, circular arrows, chevron triples, dotted motion trails, arrows inside rings and single straight arrows. Each icon is rendered as a bevelled, reflective object in either warm gold or cool silver with soft glows and subtle drop shadows that create a premium, tactile look. Suitable for overlays in motion graphics or as UI icon assets when a luxury metallic style is required.
reusable/images/metallic-gold-silver-arr.visualDifference: Unlike flat or outline arrow packs, this asset pair contrasts warm gold and cool silver 3D finishes with polished reflections, bevelled edges and soft halo lighting on a vertical brushed-metal background; the set also includes motion-dot trails and ringed targets, offering distinct directional and transition cues not found in minimalist icon sets.
reusable/images/metallic-gold-silver-arr.useCase: Use as overlay assets in short-form reels for transitions, animated callouts, product highlight pointers, directional UI hints, or premium branding intros where metallic, high-end arrow indicators are needed.
